package.name: chrono_vehicle_msgs
package.description: Message definitions for the two bridges in the split ros2_control / virtual-ECU / FMU-dynamics architecture: EcuCommand/EcuStatus (ros2_control <-> ECU, stands in for a real CAN link) and VehicleCommand/VehicleStatus (ECU <-> the FMU-wrapped dynamics node). See ../../README.md.
